title: Jaishankar calls for closer cooperation with South Korea at Jeju Forum
summary: Mr. Jaishankar also called for “greater capacity and opportunities” for the Global South to create new factors of growth, while highlighting that “the interests of a few” nations are being “openly prioritised” - without naming any country
